title: Onboard lumina-11b v1.0 — metadata, perf profiles, and changelog automation
author: Ariana Patel
description:
Motivation: Add Lumina 11B v1.0 to the model registry with validated metadata, curated performance profiles for common sequence-length buckets, and ensure it is included in the release notes/changelog automation pipeline. This PR contains the model metadata, perf profile YAML, lightweight validation tests, and a small change to the changelog generator so it picks up new model entries automatically.

Checklist: [x] model metadata (author, license, tags, tokenizer) [x] performance profiles for A100/H100 (quantized/unquantized) [x] unit + integration tests [x] changelog automation update [x] docs stub for model page [x] CI perf runs passed against perf lab

Testing and validation: I ran the perf harness (perf-canary) across the following targets: A100-40GB (fp16), H100-80GB (int8/ggml-like quant), and a CPU fallback validation. The measured median latency and throughput are included in the perf_profiles file and match our onboarding SLOs: ~95ms median latency for seq=128 on H100 int8 under batch=1 and throughput of ~420 tok/s for seq=512 on A100 fp16 (batch=8). Integration tests exercise model metadata ingestion, registry indexing, and changelog entry generation.

Implementation notes: - Added models/lumina-11b/v1.0/metadata.json containing model_id, family, tokenizer, license, source_url, tags, and recommended default runtime configs. - Added perf_profiles/lumina-11b-v1.0.yaml with profiles for common workload buckets (chat-short, chat-long, embedding-like). Profiles include kernel hints, max_seq, batch_recommendation, quantization-friendly flag, and measured throughput/latency numbers. - Hooked the new model into scripts/changelog/generate_changelog.py so new model metadata entries produce release note fragments automatically (changelog automation uses the models' release_notes field when present). - Added tests/model_registry/test_lumina_onboarding.py that validates schema conformance and that the changelog generator emits an entry. - Added docs/models/lumina-11b.md stub with quickstart and perf summary.

Backward compatibility: No API or registry schema breaking changes. The only schema tweak required was to normalize the sequence-length field name in perf_profiles to "sequence_bucket" (previously some profiles used "seq_len") — this is a linting/schema fix that was included and covered by unit tests.

Notes for reviewers: Focus review on perf profile correctness and the changelog generator change. The generator change is additive: it includes a filter to ignore draft models unless the metadata flag "release_ready" is true.

Related: ENG-1523 (model onboarding), PM-98 (product signoff for lumina), PR #189342 (previous perf profile onboarding improvements).
